wrongUnits.problem: Missing step: date processing of the values written to Gen_ftCurrentYearBase is not described. Format Dates (main.cs:51-77) turns 8-character values into yyyy/MM/dd, 6-character values (YYYYMM) into yyyy/MM/01, and anything else, unparseable values or dates before 1900 into NULL. Dates ToUniveral (main.cs:34-58) then converts each date from server local time to UTC (ToUniversalTime) unless it equals CrmMinimumDate. This affects gen_EntryDate, gen_ValueDate, gen_SalaryMonthId, Escrow, Creation_Deposit_Source_File_Date, Appendix GH and Action_Expected_Date (refund/payment dates), and is the reason Set SalaryMonthDate adds 3 hours.
wrongUnits.correct: Add a step after the amount conversion: dates YYYYMMDD / YYYYMM (→ 1st of month); invalid → NULL; converted local → UTC (Format Dates, Dates ToUniveral).

wrongUnits.problem: "תאריך פתיחה = זמן השאילתה (UTC)" omits the step "Dates To Local" that runs before the SDK create. It applies ToLocalTime() to gen_fundcreationdate (getutcdate() taken when the Full cache was loaded) and to every copied source-fund date: brokerstartdate, commission dates, customer birth/death/verified dates, deposit commission dates. wrongUnits.problem: "אם אותה בקשה מופיעה בקובץ ביותר מזוג שורות אחד, נוצרת בקשה לכל שורה מצורפת – אין סינון כפילויות בתוך הקובץ" is wrong. Both Sorts before the Merge Join have EliminateDuplicates=true. Identical source-side rows (request, account, fund type, expected date) and identical target-side rows (request, account, fund type) are collapsed, so repeated identical pairs produce one request. Several requests are created only when the same request has source-side rows with different expected dates. The Full-cache existence check still does not see requests created in the same run.
